scenarios.name: returns-an-opponents-creature-under-your-control-with-minus-one-power
scenarios.why: Oracle: Enchant creature card in a graveyard. When Animate Dead enters, return enchanted creature card to the battlefield under your control and attach Animate Dead to it; enchanted creature gets -1/-0. p0 casts it on Hill Giant (3/3) in p1's graveyard: the Giant returns under p0's control as a 2/3 with Animate Dead attached, on p0's battlefield.
